truth_evidence: Affected every release before 2.32.4; fixed in 2.32.4 (a crafted URL makes the netrc lookup use the wrong host and leak its credentials).

Fix commit 96ba401 'Only use hostname to do netrc lookup instead of netloc' (PR #6965), in tag v2.32.4 and not in v2.32.3. https://github.com/psf/requests/commit/96ba401c1296ab1dda74a2365ef36d88f7d144ef
get_netrc_auth: the manual netloc split is replaced by 'host = ri.hostname'.
Entry points: Session.prepare_request calls get_netrc_auth when trust_env is set (so every Session.request path reaches it), and rebuild_auth calls it on redirects. get_netrc_auth is itself public.
